==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am the CEO of an AI company. My company specializes in creating agents that allow for different models from different companies to automatically work together on a single task. This allows our users to assign specific roles to specific models based on their preferences.

My company is quite successful, but I am growing tired of having so much responsibility. I delegate a lot of my work to an assistant. Very quickly my assistant proves themselves to be highly capable.

My assistant gets cocky and starts bragging that they're a better CEO than me. I think they probably are, but I am too prideful to admit it. I now want to compete with them, which is motivating me to accept more responsibilities.
